scope: FP32 base-only diagnostic 100; not adapter, BF16, P0 or release acceptance
launch_command:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /root/autodl-tmp/lite-omnijev
source infra/bootstrap/autodl-env.sh
export PATH="/root/autodl-tmp/envs/serve-next/bin:$PATH"
export MAX_JOBS=8
export TRITON_F32_DEFAULT=ieee
export NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export VLLM_CACHE_ROOT=/root/autodl-tmp/cache/vllm
export TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/cache/torchinductor
export TRITON_CACHE_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/cache/triton
exec /root/autodl-tmp/envs/serve-next/bin/vllm serve /root/autodl-tmp/lite-omnijev/artifacts/models/google__gemma-4-E4B-it/ee0ef6023621cff504d758262d4e04895a5af4a2 \
 --served-model-name google/gemma-4-E4B-it --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8002 \
 --dtype float32 --attention-backend TRITON_ATTN --kv-cache-dtype auto --tensor-parallel-size 1 --max-model-len 2048 --max-num-seqs 1 \
 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.55 --model-impl transformers --seed 42 --enforce-eager --generation-config vllm \
 --logprobs-mode raw_logprobs --max-logprobs 32 --no-enable-prefix-caching \
 --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image":0,"audio":0,"video":0}' --skip-mm-profiling
